property_summary: After any valid fallback call (exactly 10 ether at a strictly later timestamp), C's remaining balance is fully determined by the payout rule: 0 when block.number % 15 == 0 (it transfers its ENTIRE balance) and 20 ether otherwise; the mutant transfers only 1 ether, leaving 19 ether in the divisible case and violating this rule.
change_summary: Replace the transfer of the full balance with a fixed `transfer(1 ether)`, changing the amount sent to the caller.
